name: Rock Music
overview: Scripture encourages believers to worship God with skillful and joyful expression, as seen in Psalms 33:3's call to sing a new song and play with loud noise. True worship honors the Lord in holiness and reverence, reflecting the beauty of His sanctuary (Psalms 96:9), and must be done in spirit and truth (John 4:24). Ephesians 5:19 highlights the importance of heartfelt melody through psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, emphasizing worship that is sincere and directed to the Lord.
